tlog.msg: Deploying to a new island — new map sheets are in the library [P].

CHAPTER 3.1 — ROLLING STOCK (NORMAL). Enemy convoy, four vehicles, moving on the low ground near grid 259 553. Lead the column and time your fire for effect — or catch them when they pull in somewhere. If the head of the column runs off the end of the road, they are gone.
Par time for full stars: 7:00.
MET: wind from 5000 mils at 2 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 244 553, ground elev 265 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "LATRINE" grid 257 548 (grid brg 2036) · AB1002 "SAWMILL" grid 268 540 (grid brg 2118). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages KELUFA and PARA — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.

>>> THE JOB: Enemy convoy, four vehicles, moving on the low ground near grid 259 553. Lead the column and time your fire for effect — or catch them when they pull in somewhere. If the head of the column runs off the end of the road, they are gone.
SOUTHEAST OF THE RADIO MAST, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT
This net has seen career-enders, mercy kills, and one observer who called fire on his own foxhole by accident. Let us find out which one you are, over.

MUSTANG 12, HELLHOUND FIRES — BATTALION S-TWO, WHO WERE VERY PLEASED WITH THEMSELVES REPORTS ACTIVITY IN THIS GENERAL AREA — SOUTHEAST OF THE RADIO MAST, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT. MOTORISED COLUMN ON THE MOVE. 18 MINUTES OLD, OVER.
THAT IS ALL THEY GAVE ME. FOUR VEHICLES IN COLUMN, CARGO TRUCKS. ESCORT UNKNOWN. NO ARMOUR REPORTED. NOTHING FINER, OVER.
That is a CUE, MUSTANG, not a target location. Somebody has to actually look. That somebody is you.
HINT: Send a call for fire — grid: "adjust fire, grid 123 456, infantry in the open, over" (with YOUR target grid) — or polar: "adjust fire, direction 4400, distance 2100, troops in the open, over".
The column has pulled in at a crew halt. Engines idling. This window will not stay open.
HELLHOUND FIRES, THIS IS MUSTANG 12, ADJUST FIRE, GRID 259561, LINEAR SHEAF, CONVOY OF TRUCKS HALTED, OVER
